verdict.rationale: Docs claim broad team collaboration ("Unlimited Teams - Collaborate freely") but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of live cursors or real-time simultaneous editing, and hands-on reports describe multiplayer sessions crashing or lagging heavily with just a handful of concurrent users editing (comm-10, comm-11), directly undercutting the 'instant sync, whole team editing simultaneously' claim. missing for 10: first-party documentation of live cursors/real-time sync mechanics, independent confirmation that simultaneous multi-user editing performs reliably at scale.
